description: This file declares the SecuredWebSocketClient class within the impl namespace, which implements the IWebSocketClient interface and manages a secure WebSocket connection using TLS. It includes constructors, destructor, and methods for connecting, disconnecting, and retrieving the connection type. It also holds a WebSocketClientImpl object with TLS enabled.

classes.name: impl::SecuredWebSocketClient
classes.description: A class that provides a secure WebSocket client implementation with TLS support, handling connection lifecycle and embedding a TLS-enabled WebSocket client instance.

methods.name: SecuredWebSocketClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket client with audio player and security parameters.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the WebSocket connection to the specified URI.

methods.name: getConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the connection.
